HARD_ANOMALY_CONTRACT.definition: positive finite canonical rows; VWAP=amount/volume; HARD_BELOW=VWAP < low*0.5; HARD_ABOVE=VWAP > high*2.0; one-price rows additionally HARD when R=amount/(close*volume) < 0.5 or > 2.0
HARD_ANOMALY_CONTRACT.rationale: 0.5x/2.0x margins are deliberately huge so float noise, VWAP-vs-close differences, and ordinary rounded bars cannot create false positives; outside-[low,high] rows inside the margins stay SOFT diagnostics

LISTING_DISTANCE.IPO_EARLY_PERIOD_CONCENTRATION: SUPPORTED (99.4% of hard anomalies within 20 days of listing)

BOUNDED_SAMPLE.algorithm: symbols sorted by hard-anomaly count desc (stable), top 8, plus 300546.SZ; per symbol first 2 anomalous dates ascending; +4 healthy controls by same year/exchange (largest-volume rows)

TDX_WIRE_DIAGNOSIS.note: 3 independently healthy endpoints; every sample key returned identical native volumes on all 3

PER_KEY_CLASSIFICATION: TDX_VENDOR_HISTORICAL_VOLUME_ANOMALY (all sampled anomalous keys: 3 healthy TDX endpoints agree; TDX native x100 == canonical exactly; TDX amount == BaoStock amount; TDX volume disagrees with BaoStock volume by non-constant factor; BaoStock amount/volume is close-consistent while TDX is not)
ROOT_CAUSE_DETAIL: TDX endpoints (3 independently healthy) return identical native volumes; R3 adapter applies x100 exactly (canonical == native*100 in every sample); TDX amount equals BaoStock amount; but TDX volume is internally inconsistent with its own amount (A/V far inside/outside the price range) and disagrees with BaoStock volume by non-constant factors (e.g. 300546 09-30: TDX 205600 vs BS 1600). The defect is in the TDX vendor historical volume field for IPO early-period rows; it is NOT an endpoint inconsistency, NOT a decoder defect, NOT an R3 transform defect.
REPAIR_SCOPE_NOTE: 1110 rows / 466 symbols, 99.4% within 20 days of listing; BaoStock provides close-consistent rows for the anomaly set; a bounded secondary-repair candidate exists but no repair is executed here and Sol approval + versioned normalizer with explicit volume-unit contract remain required.

STRATEGY_IMPACT.scope: IPO early-period SH/SZ rows (~1110 canonical rows, 466 symbols)
